text: On data_seed 1 with m2 fixed, the 12000-step N=64 vs N=128 force gap is large in seeds 21-22 and small in seeds 20 and 23. If every N=64 value is read from probes_final at layer 1 (control plus margin) instead of the trajectory field, do the seeds still fall into two clusters? Or is the gap a continuous per-seed quantity that shrinks with training wherever N=64 has levelled off?
